mapper.select: SELECT j.id FROM afv_media_job j JOIN afv_canvas_media_import b ON b.job_id = j.id WHERE j.actor_user_id = #{actor} AND j.request_id = #{requestId} AND b.canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND b.actor_team_id <=> #{teamId}

SELECT j.id FROM afv_canvas_media_import b JOIN afv_media_job j ON j.id = b.job_id WHERE b.canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND j.actor_user_id = #{actor} AND b.actor_team_id <=> #{teamId} AND b.node_run_id IS NULL AND (j.status IN ('QUEUED','WAITING','RUNNING') OR (j.cancel_requested = FALSE AND JSON_EXTRACT(b.placement_json, '$.automatic') = TRUE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(j.checkpoint_json, '$.items[*]' COLUMNS( item_status VARCHAR(24) PATH '$.status', command_id VARCHAR(36) PATH '$.commandId')) item WHERE item.item_status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND item.command_id IS NULL))) ORDER BY b.created_at, b.job_id LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_media_import(job_id, canvas_id, actor_team_id, placement_json, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{canvasId}, #{teamId}, #{placement}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
